mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS "id", d.doc_no AS "docNo", d.biz_date AS "bizDate", w.name AS "warehouseName", d.total_qty AS "totalQty", d.reversed AS "reversed" FROM wms_stock_doc d JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = d.warehouse_id WHERE d.kind = 'IN' AND d.biz_type = 'OPENING' ORDER BY d.id
SELECT kind AS "kind", COUNT(*) AS "count", COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS "amount" FROM fin_bill WHERE source_type = 'MANUAL' GROUP BY kind
